LESSON: DIVISIONS OF THE QUR’AN • AYAT • JUZUU • MANZIL • RUK’U • SURAH • MAKKAN SURAH MADINAN SURAH

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an 1.1 Modes of preservation of the Qur’an (4 lessons) By the end of the sub
Topic 1.2: Divisions of the Qur’an • ayat • juzuu • manzil • ruk’u • surah • Makkan Surah Madinan Surah
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Divisions of the Qur’an • ayat • juzuu • manzil • ruk’u • surah • Makkan Surah Madinan Surah, part of Qur’an 1.1 Modes of preservation of the Qur’an (4 lessons) By the end of the sub in Grade 8 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How do the divisions of the Qur’an help in studying it?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss the divisions of the Qur’an and make charts and display,

2. identify the divisions of the Qur’an from a Mus’ haf in groups and make notes,

3. research online/from available reference materials on the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan surahs and make a class presentation.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the divisions of the Qur’an and make charts and display,
2. identify the divisions of the Qur’an from a Mus’ haf in groups and make notes,
3. research online/from available reference materials on the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan surahs and make a class presentation.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Divisions of the Qur’an • ayat • juzuu • manzil • ruk’u • surah • Makkan Surah Madinan Surah together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: the skills of teamwork, listening and speaking effectively are developed through

group discussions and presentation.

Values:
• Unity is enhanced as learners discuss the divisions of the Qur’an in groups.

• Respect enhanced as learners respect each other’s views during group discussions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social awareness skill: learners develop effective communication skills when they discuss the divisions of the Qur’an in groups

and make a class presentation.

Link to other subjects

English: the learner will develop effective communication skills when they discuss the divisions of the Qur’an in groups and

make a class presentation which is related to communication skills in English
